caption: The drawing depicts a single, central object: an oval-shaped wooden table. The tabletop is rendered in rich brown tones with visible wood grain texture, suggesting a polished wooden surface. The table is supported by two wide, ornately cut legs connected near the bottom by a horizontal stretcher for stability, all matching the color and grain of the tabletop. The side panels between the legs are also made of wood and are contoured with curved lines. The table sits on a light beige background, bordered by a thin, dark line forming a rectangular frame around the composition. There are no additional objects or elements present in the drawing.
title: Hutch Table
